instruction: Business rule change: no discount may take more than 50% off a line. Update pricing.discount.apply_discount so that any discount above pricing.discount.MAX_DISCOUNT_BPS (5000 bps) is reduced to the cap; for example a 70% coupon on 1000 cents yields 500 cents. Discounts at or below the cap behave as before, and pricing.cart totals must follow the rule. Run the tests in tests/; do not edit the tests.
